title: SwitchControl 1.0.7 — Smoother Launch
headline: The app now opens with a clean, stutter-free animation every time. Logo loads before the window appears and heavy background tasks wait until you're in the app.
changes: Fixed launch visual race — logo and background are now fully rendered before the window becomes visible
GPU performance data collection now starts 2 seconds after launch instead of competing with the opening animation
Eliminated stutter during the splash screen caused by PowerShell cold-start running at the same moment as first paint
Developer tools no longer auto-open during normal launches, removing hidden overhead on startup
